_note: Her micro-reactions in Khand (r4-khand). SHAPES, not lines: {slot} = a fact the law put on screen; a leading {?key=a|b} makes a shape usable only when that fact is one of the values (every law_refused shape names its refusal, every misconception shape its mal-rule). She notices the world, never judges the child: no verdict words, no praise of the person, no pressure (shared/play.ts REACTION_BANNED; tests/r4-khand-react.test.mjs). The key (the array's count, the next square or cube number, the best field) is never said before the child makes it (server/play/react.js hiddenOf).
